001package com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.event.economy;
002
003/**
004 * The terminal reason for a shop transaction that did not complete successfully.
005 */
006public enum ShopTransactionFailureReason {
007  /** A plugin cancelled the pre-transaction event. */
008  CANCELLED,
009  /** The account funding the transaction did not have enough money. */
010  INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS,
011  /** The economy provider could not commit the money transaction. */
012  ECONOMY_TRANSACTION_FAILED,
013  /** The item transfer failed after the money transaction and triggered a rollback. */
014  SHOP_OPERATION_FAILED,
015  /** An unexpected exception interrupted the transaction. */
016  INTERNAL_ERROR
017}
